subject: [PATCH 2/2] rtc: cmos: Honor explicit use_acpi_alarm parameter value

2026-09-09.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue where the rtc_cmos driver ignores explicit use_acpi_alarm parameter values set on the command line. The problem occurs because the parameter is read-only and its default value is false, making it impossible to distinguish between an omitted argument and an explicit false value. To solve this, a custom setter function is added to record whether parsing occurred and skip automatic selection when it did. This change ensures that explicit false values are honored as expected.
